slides.label: Swipe
slides.stat_label: of protein per kg of body weight a day, for healthy adults
chips: At 60 kg: about 50 g a day
slides.fine: Source: ICMR-NIN, Nutrient Requirements for Indians, 2020 (RDA, healthy adults). General information only, not medical advice. Needs differ in pregnancy, older age, kidney disease and heavy training.

slides.headline: Start with your weight.
slides.body: Multiply your body weight in kg by 0.83 to get your daily protein in grams.

slides.headline: Spread it across meals.
slides.body: Aim for a protein food at breakfast, lunch and dinner rather than one large serving.

slides.headline: Mix your sources.
slides.body: Combining cereals with pulses, like dal with rice or roti, improves protein quality.

slides.headline: Find your number, free.
slides.body: Our free Protein Calculator on nnwa.in works it out with Indian foods. Learn to plan it for others in NNWA's Certification in Nutrition.
